resources.string: ① Allow display over other apps
How much the pet shakes when you type. \"None\" just switches images without moving.
When ON, the pet appears automatically whenever you open another app. When OFF, it only shows after tapping button ③.
When ON, taps pass through to the app underneath and the pet can\'t be dragged.
Used whenever you haven\'t added any custom images in the Images tab.
Android doesn\'t allow apps to change their own icon after install. Instead, you can add a shortcut with an image you pick to the home screen. Use that shortcut to open the app.
Pick an image and add to home screen
This device doesn\'t support adding icons to the home screen
Shown when you\'re not typing. With several, one is picked at random each time it goes idle. If empty, the 1st typing image (or the built-in color) is used.
While typing, images switch 1st → 2nd → 3rd… and loop back to the 1st. Add alternates to a number and one of them is picked at random each time that number comes up.

When you type a registered character, one of its images is shown at random. You can assign several characters to one image (e.g. \"a\" and \"u\" for a gloomy face). Full-width and half-width are treated as different characters. Nothing is saved or sent \u2014 it only checks the few characters right before where you typed, in the moment.
Save your images (idle, typing, character triggers) and built-in color per character. Edits in the Images tab apply to the character marked \"editing\".
You can\'t delete the last character
The faint shadow under the pet. Turn it off if it looks odd with your transparent images.
Tap to show or hide. Each character on screen can be dragged around separately.
Used so the pet can react to typing. It only notices that a text field changed; nothing is saved or sent. Password fields are never read.
Apps report typing in different ways. Only change these if some app does not react.
For apps that only report cursor position and not text changes (e.g. WebView). Some apps may then react twice.
Treat the send button as Enter
In a single-line field, the IME send/search key clears the field without inserting a newline. Treat that as Enter.
Save characters, images and settings into a single file. Useful before changing phones or reinstalling.
This overwrites your current settings and images with the backup. Continue?
That many characters arriving at once is treated as a paste. Smaller reacts more easily, but IMEs that insert spaces while typing pinyin will false-trigger more often.
Note: copying is detected by seeing you press the Copy button in the selection menu. The clipboard itself is never read (Android 10+ forbids that for ordinary apps).
Also treat selection collapse as copy
When ON, finishing a selection without using the menu also counts as a copy. Fast scroll-selection can then false-trigger.
For investigating why copy etc. does not react. Records event types and labels on this device only; nothing is sent out.
No records yet. Turn this on, then try copying.
